q1: SELECT A.PROJECT_ID, ROUND(AVG(B.EXPERIENCE_YEARS), 2) AS AVERAGE_YEARS FROM PROJECT AS A INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE AS B ON A.EMPLOYEE_ID = B.EMPLOYEE_ID GROUP BY A.PROJECT_ID
q2: SELECT PROJECT_ID, ROUND(AVG(EXPERIENCE_YEARS), 2) AS AVERAGE_YEARS FROM PROJECT LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE ON PROJECT.EMPLOYEE_ID = EMPLOYEE.EMPLOYEE_ID GROUP BY PROJECT_ID

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 uses an INNER JOIN, which excludes projects without any employees, while Q2 uses a LEFT JOIN, which includes all projects, even those without employees, and assigns NULL for employee-related fields.
